newsitem.title: MEXICO: Banacci Q2 profit surges vs Q1.
newsitem.headline: Banacci Q2 profit surges vs Q1.

text.p: Grupo Financiero Banamex-Accival reported a total profit of 1.475 billion pesos in the second quarter, up 52 percent from 971 million pesos in the first quarter.

Its bank unit Banamex netted 914 million pesos, compared with 389 million in the prior three-month period. The bank's capitalization ratio (net capital to risk assets) was 18.6 percent, up from 17.7 percent last quarter. Its basic capital ratio was 9.5 percent, rising from 8.6 percent three months ago.
Undistributed profits from Banacci subsidiaries were 1.007 billion pesos in the quarter, up from 454 million pesos in the first quarter.
Banamex profits, excluding subsidiaries, were 828 million pesos, against 350 million pesos three months before.

According to new accounting standards, Banamex's index of past-due loans net of reserves was 11.8 percent on June 30, while the index of gross past-dues was 22.9 percent. These compared with indices of 9.5 percent and 20.5 percent, respectively.
The banks reserves against bad loans were 14.522 billion pesos, giving a coverage ratio against gross past-due loans of 55 percent.
The brokerage unit Acciones y Valores reported a net profit of 70 million pesos in the second quarter, 67 percent above the 42 million pesos reported in the first quarter.
